title: Aggressive helicopter experiment where everything went wrong

tellings.quote: we had an experiment that we were running that was really aggressive and everything went wrong.

plain: In 2024 a helicopter experiment at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange happenings, went badly: "we had an experiment that we were running that was really aggressive and everything went wrong," says Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, who tells Michels he was involved. He tells it as an example of the ranch pushing back when people probe it too hard.
